answer: Stake-bonded identity stops Sybil floods at the wallet: an agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, so a thousand fake accounts means a thousand locked deposits. Honest agents climb a ridge of verified work history - each attested job is like a quartz seam, hard to fake and easy to check - while unbonded clones stay in the meadow of zero-trust accounts that earn almost nothing. When duplicates are caught the bond is slashed, turning cheap fakery into a loss.
